notes.title: The Stonks Market is Now Available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/25fe395ca8e9c8e3e697ed2ac9d78971433d623f.png[/img]

[i]How's your portfolio doing?[/i]

Today we're pleased to release [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554080]The Stonks Market[/url][/b], right here on Steam. It's a simple trading simulator with a funny story about a rather clueless guy who gets into all kinds of trouble through the stock market.

You'll get access to a basic trading terminal, a stimulus check, and enough time to risk it all gambling on bad plays you've barely researched. All of this while you contend with a frustrated wife, too many know-it-all advisors, and the crippling fear of losing it all in an instant. Kinda like real-life, huh?

 [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/e5897f78b0550828efc32164b8e789b89a33d162.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/7dd5875707b4d4bf76c798b20bfecfcd38f8fc12.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/4f361d8313e12f7becca7bfedcb7903ee21b75e1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/886ee68add5c804f1bd88f273316353a8fd26473.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/4939a247b3b956d695b042d49d869b7ee4143e98.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/06a8eb6883f9f8f57763dd68d1404ea119e79da5.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/9683675a3db573cc8d09c196b6eb46b113537c2e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/c8711d7cb90376669f022f459fd119df39f7f9f4.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/98343e79c7032f572fc88d8a8d9d1e9bfd5801ae.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/f691051397262966098218cde1f56dd70e15fcfe.png[/img][/url]

Whether you're an avid stock bro, a crayon-eating monkey, or never touched a trading app in your life, [b]The Stonks Market[/b] is worth a few laughs. We hope you enjoy all its wild characters and bizarre scenarios.

------

[h2]ALL APES TO THE MOON! 🚀 💎🙌[/h2]

notes.title: 6 Month Celebration - SAM/ASM Saga Sale
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5611244/cf8841e37e2e617e40209b5645988d277e2e2322.png[/img]
Wow. The calendar just kind of melted away, huh?
It feels like yesterday we were prepping for launch, and now we're officially 6 months past release.
To celebrate, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440][b]SAM is 30% off[/b][/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/274310][b]ASM is 70% off[/b][/url] until [b]October 12[/b].

A lot has happened in that time (both in-game, and out), but it's been a great ride so far.

There have been nearly [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/441440?emclan=103582791453696086&emgid=2915473311420658231]60 build updates[/url] for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440][b]Sometimes Always Monsters[/b][/url], including [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1NCxTU6z4gNTWzwF1XppNqhCkm6-U2c1r6-KGZoX3FzY/edit?usp=sharing]over 600 individual changes[/url], additions or improvements, along with around [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/441440?emclan=103582791453696086&emgid=2915473311420658231]30 significant new content additions[/url] (features, scenes, or significant characters).

Needless to say, the game has changed a lot since launch, and will continue to evolve as we casually work on it. We still love adding things, improving the experience, and expanding the world players can explore with each subsequent playthrough. Thanks to its success, we have runway to continue doing this for the foreseeable future, and appreciate all of the feedback we've been given from the community.

On top of the updates, we managed to drop some [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341860/][b]Hot DLC[/b][/url], release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361110][b]Karen: An Outrage Simulator[/b][/url] to rave reviews (our highest rated game ever), complete [url=http://www.vagabonddog.com/blog/no-words-games]two game jams[/url] with our community, start preliminary work on our next major project, and maintain a routine [url=http://twitch.tv/vagabonddog]streaming schedule[/url].

It's been a wild half-year, and we couldn't be happier with all that's happened. Despite the world being so turbulent, our community has been incredibly supportive of our efforts, and we can't thank y'all enough. This has been one of the most productive periods in our company's history, and we've got your motivation to thank for it.

Take care, and we'll see you at the next update!
[h3]- VD[/h3]

notes.title: ASM Update Prepares for Sequel's Release
notes.notes:
Hey folks,
Today we're pushing out an update to [b]Always Sometimes Monsters[/b] that prepares some backend stuff for its connectivity and save file imports to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/]the sequel[/url] that [b]releases tomorrow[/b] morning. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/

We've made it possible for you to bring your save files into the new game, as well as added some fun content in the end-game house for those of you who've already finished. Just take a look in the secret server room in the shed to see what "The Devs" have been up to.

It's been a long time coming, but we're so happy to share this new update with you and to finally have you all ready to jump into [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/]Sometimes Always Monsters[/url] for the first time with your original ASM continuity. If you need more detailed instructions, you can [url=http://www.vagabonddog.com/blog/save-imports]check out the blog post we made on the topic.
[/url]
If you haven't gotten a look at the new game yet, take a look at the trailer:
[previewyoutube=1mrSelnqaLM;full][/previewyoutube]

Naturally, we'll be watching the forums for feedback on the update. If you have any questions or issues, that's a great place to drop a line and let us know.

Thanks to all your patient waiting for this update and release, we hope you enjoy!

- Vagabond Dog

notes.title: Sequel Launch - PAX, Pricing & Discounts
notes.notes:
With only a month left until [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/]Sometimes Always Monsters[/url] finally releases, we've had a few questions about pricing. We thought we'd take the opportunity to make the announcements now so that nobody feels left out or misses their chance to get the best deal.
[quote]Across all storefronts, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/][b]Sometimes Always Monsters[/b][/url] will be [b]$19.99 USD[/b]

We’re offering Steam Key pre-orders at [url=http://vagabonddog.com/store/sam][b]VagabondDog.com[/b][/url] for [b]$14.99 USD[/b]

During the first week of release, we will be offering a more moderate discount.[/quote]
Of course, even if you're already set to get the game on [b]April 2, 2020[/b], it would help us a lot if you wishlisted the game before launch day. It's like blessing us with your algorithmic influence!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/

We're also really excited to announce that we'll be making an appearance at [b]PAX East 2020[/b] in [b]Boston[/b]. Our setup will be located in the [url=http://www.indiemegabooth.com]Indie Megabooth[/url] in booth [b]#22040[/b]. Come by and say hello, grab some swag, and play the latest demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5611244/477689133e558e90ed069dc09b60647f56e684e2.png[/img]

Finally, we've been posting some new screenshots on our [url=http://twitter.com/vagabonddog]Twitter[/url]. If you're just can't wait for release, hopefully some of these will help soothe the continuing agony of waiting.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5611244/f10a98d2f0019ed1756eded1e352e1ae28926d07.png] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5611244/245ca41fd677f1f28234c66319a28123b92b354d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5611244/967257ba6115a309e2d24a944a61a8b2a4f26cac.png] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5611244/601ebcb258daa118aafb707fbc5408043c9fd5fb.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5611244/84a9b0eb13ebd7c14770aa700f9e44cba9482b1a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5611244/58cc0a0123efc49f460ce00fff3daf9223ec6794.png[/img] [/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5611244/504365e02a5973fe2b12c45ca36989719358251f.png] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5611244/fb9e64654446178edd09dbe6e541daae064060dc.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5611244/a0213bc6f03e19236846c14de456bd6a43271a1e.png] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5611244/2cfd91fb59138de05d0abd7975bee418b9d1d8fc.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Launch Trailer Premieres on Feb 3rd
notes.notes:
Hey Vagabonds,
It's been a while since we posted, hasn't it?
Bet you thought we were dead, or something.

For those of you who've kept up with us, you're probably aware that we've been working on a sequel to [b]Always Sometimes Monsters[/b] that will let you carry on your adventure. Finally, it's almost here.

We're just updating you now to let you know that [b]Monday, Feb 3rd at 10:30 AM EST[/b], we will be premiering the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1mrSelnqaLM]Launch Trailer[/url] for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/Sometimes_Always_Monsters/][b]Sometimes Always Monsters[/b][/url] on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCMKgzspA8B4Fzm7-OUCXkOw][b]YouTube channel[/b][/url].

notes.title: New Video: Will O'Neill on Writing
notes.notes:
Greetings Vagabonds,
There's a new video on the [url=http://youtube.com/c/VagabondDog/]YouTube channel[/url] today.
It features indie game and narrative maven, Will O'Neill.
https://youtu.be/0e70i9r8hvI
For those of you who aren't familiar with the man, Will O'Neill is another Toronto-born-RPG-Making-wordsmith who broke onto the scene circa PAX East 2014. He's been slinging verbs and sharpening adjectives across the industry ever since.

We are very fortunate to have him join Vagabond Dog as an Associate Writer to help develop an extensive series of unique vignette sequences that help define and expand the profiles of our bus friend characters in [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/]Sometimes Always Monsters[/url]. There's been one written for every possible pairing in the game, centralized on how the characters experience each other outside the purview of your influence.

Some other games Will has written for:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/288040/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/350970/

notes.title: Vagabond Dog Launches YouTube Channel
notes.notes:
[url=youtube.com/c/VagabondDog][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24174678/2b8bb44533460c32706a02aea280131f38bdeefa.png[/img][/url]

Watch Here: http://youtube.com/c/VagabondDog
------------------------------

Hello Vagabonds,
We know you have been waiting patiently for updates on our sequel, Sometimes Always Monsters. Many of you had begun to speculate if we'd abandoned the project, run into extreme difficulty, or just plain died.

The truth is, we have been electively quiet and hard at work on the game.

It is a much bigger endeavour than we thought when first announcing our optimistic 2016 release plan. Since failing that, we have all been working overtime so that the game may meet our internal quality standards and release to all of you as soon as possible.

Rest assured, the game is getting better each day.
However, despite all of this, you faithful deserve updates.

We know how much you miss us on the daily, but this recent absence from the community has pushed the team in exciting new directions.

So, we've partnered with an independent production company to launch our official YouTube channel.

This channel is currently featuring a short documentary and a playlist of clips from our west-coast bus tour on the way to PAX West. 

We call it...
[b]Vagabond Dog Presents: A Bus Ride to Eternity/Oblivion[/b]

notes.title: 2 Year Anniversary Patch - ASM 126
notes.notes:
Today marks 2 years since we released [i]Always Sometimes Monsters[/i]. We thought about running a sale to help celebrate the occasion, but thought it would be a more meaningful gesture of appreciation for all your support if we updated the game instead.

Thanks to all of you for playing, and supporting us this far.

[b]ASM 126 - PATCH NOTES[/b]
==============================
- Updated swimming pool sprites with new bathing suits
- Replaced vent-crawling sprites with more appropriate animation
- Changed some dialogue in the Faith Beach pre-wedding scene
- Fixed casino toilets so Sam can use them
- Updated conversation with Bellinger at casino
- RasmusMan received improved score calculation for efficiency
- Prevented Markansas sequences from misfiring
- Secret alternate ending added
- Improved player guidance with concierge in Union Club House
- Expanded conversations with Jake/Justin
- Fixed impassable safe bug in Warehouse Office
- Save import preparation for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/] Sometimes Always Monsters[/url]

notes.title: Sometimes Always Monsters, Sometimes, Always Always Sometimes Monsters Sometimes, Monsters
notes.notes:
2014’s Always Sometimes Monsters is a curious RPG, about an author crossing the USA to break up a wedding after being kicked out their apartment, with plenty of unpleasant decisions, prejudice, and hardship along the way. Ben’s Wot I Think called it “brilliant but flawed.” Now developers Vagabond Dog are showing off more of their sequel named Sometimes Always Monsters [official site], which surely won’t cause any confusion. Good news: everything turned out great! Bad news: it’s all going wrong!

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Asset Pack for RPG Maker VX Ace Now Available
notes.notes:
[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/321100/header.jpg?t=1420850537]

Hey Vagabonds,
We've had a lot of people e-mail, tweet, and ask us in person how we got started making Always Sometimes Monsters and the always simple to use RPG Maker system is invariably part of our answer.

While RPG Maker VX Ace (and it's grandpappy XP) are incredibly easy to use, with the right dedication and some inventive thinking it can do a lot of things you'd never expect from such a neophyte-friendly tool.

With that in mind, we are happy to announce that in partnership with Degica and the folks at RPG Maker Web we are launching [i]Environments Inspired by Always Sometimes Monsters[/i].

This is a fully-featured tileset system for RPG Maker VX Ace that uses resources pulled from Always Sometimes Monsters and reformatted to work in any modern-setting project. Whether you're producing a fangame or an original work, this pack will get you on your way to building fleshed out cities, offices, hospitals, homes, and a whole lot more.

If you're interested in developing games, RPG Maker is a great place to start and hopefully this new asset pack will help you on that journey.

You can grab it here, discounted temporarily:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/321100/

All the best,
Vagabond Dog

notes.title: Always Sometimes Monsters is Now Available
notes.notes: Dear Vagabonds, It is our pleasure to inform you that [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/274310]Always Sometimes Monsters[/url] has officially been released for your enjoyment! As of right now you can download the game and begin your adventure! Once you finish your first playthrough of the game, please join us in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/274310/discussions/]Community Hub[/url] to discuss your experience with the game and compare it with other players. We are looking forward to hearing how everyone's stories unfolded as well as what you thought of the choices you made along the way. Perhaps you may even uncover a few secrets by joining the conversation. Thank you so much for your support. All the best, [b]Vagabond Dog[/b]
